title: Part 15
content_zh: Sun Wukong descended into the Dragon King's palace beneath the Eastern Sea and demanded a weapon worthy of his strength. The dragon king brought out spear after spear, halberd after halberd — the monkey broke them all like toothpicks. Finally, the dragon queen whispered about the Great Iron Pillar that held down the ocean floor.
